title: Ji-Ming-San enhances intestinal circadian rhythms and mitigates colitis in mice: The role of epithelial RORalpha.
authors: Pan, Zhixi; Liu, Jiahui; Lin, Shubin; Li, Zhennan; Qin, Shumin; Wu, Haomeng; Li, Feng; Wu, Baojian; Wang, Shuai
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药Ji-Ming-San通过RORalpha调节肠道昼夜节律并缓解结肠炎，涉及RORalpha与NF-kappaB靶基因的染色质结合，但核心是炎症与节律调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，且方法以实验为主，无AI或物理模拟。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ji-Ming-San (JMS), a traditional Chinese medicine, exhibits time-dependent pharmacological effects, suggesting its potential as a circadian clock modulator. However, the precise mechanisms by which JMS regulates circadian rhythms remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study aims to elucidate how JMS influences the local circadian clock machinery, and move beyond association to mechanistic discovery. METHODS: A jet lag model of circadian disruption was used to assess the regulatory effects of JMS on circadian behavior and clock gene expression. The impact of JMS on clock genes was examined in colon epithelial cells. Non-targeted metabolomics was utilized to identify key components and potential pathways. Network pharmacology, molecular docking, Gal4 co-transfection assays, and RNA sequencing were conducted to explore potential JMS targets. Chromatin immunoprecipitation assays were performed to investigate the transcriptional regulation mechanisms. RESULTS: JMS restored circadian rhythms in locomotor activity and intestinal clock gene expression in jet-lagged mice. Under colitis conditions, JMS reduced pathological severity and inflammation in mice with circadian disruption by upregulating BMAL1 and PER2. In mice with normal circadian rhythms, the protective effect of JMS was observed during the remission phase of colitis. At the cellular level, JMS activated RORalpha and enhanced the transcription and expression of BMAL1 and PER2 in colonic epithelial cells. Metabolomics and RNA sequencing revealed that JMS inhibited NF-kappaB signaling, contributing to its anti-inflammatory action. Mechanistically, JMS enhanced RORalpha/HDAC3 binding to NF-kappaB target genes in epithelial cells, leading to reduced H3K9Ac levels and repression of Il-1beta and Tnf-alpha, while epithelial RORalpha knockdown abolished the anti-inflammatory effects. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates that JMS activates epithelial RORalpha to restore circadian rhythm in the colon and suppresses NF-kappaB signaling, ultimately promoting colitis recovery These findings underscore the role of JMS in regulating intestinal circadian rhythm and highlight its potential as a chronotherapeutic strategy for colitis.
abstract_zh: 背景：鸡鸣散（Ji-Ming-San, JMS）作为一种传统中药，表现出时间依赖性药理效应，提示其可能作为昼夜节律调节剂。然而，JMS调节昼夜节律的具体机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在阐明JMS如何影响局部昼夜节律机制，并超越关联性研究，深入机制发现。方法：采用昼夜节律紊乱的时差模型，评估JMS对昼夜节律行为和时钟基因表达的调节作用。在结肠上皮细胞中检测JMS对时钟基因的影响。利用非靶向代谢组学鉴定关键成分和潜在通路。通过网络药理学、分子对接、Gal4共转染实验和RNA测序探索JMS的潜在靶点。采用染色质免疫沉淀实验研究转录调控机制。结果：JMS恢复了时差小鼠的运动活性和肠道时钟基因表达的昼夜节律。在结肠炎条件下，JMS通过上调BMAL1和PER2，减轻了昼夜节律紊乱小鼠的病理严重程度和炎症。在昼夜节律正常的小鼠中，JMS的保护作用在结肠炎缓解期被观察到。在细胞水平上，JMS激活RORalpha，并增强结肠上皮细胞中BMAL1和PER2的转录和表达。代谢组学和RNA测序揭示，JMS抑制NF-kappaB信号通路，有助于其抗炎作用。机制上，JMS增强上皮细胞中RORalpha/HDAC3与NF-kappaB靶基因的结合，导致H3K9Ac水平降低，并抑制Il-1beta和Tnf-alpha，而上皮RORalpha敲低则消除了抗炎效应。结论：本研究证明，JMS激活上皮RORalpha以恢复结肠昼夜节律，并抑制NF-kappaB信号通路，最终促进结肠炎恢复。这些发现强调了JMS在调节肠道昼夜节律中的作用，并凸显其作为结肠炎时辰治疗策略的潜力。
